content.text: up to 20 mg/kg elemental iron is not toxic; > 60 mg/kg can cause severe toxicity. Severe toxicity (metabolic acidosis, shock, severe gastroenteritis or serum iron > 500 mcg/dL): IV deferoxamine, with IV hydration. Radiopaque tablets on x-ray: whole-bowel irrigation; activated charcoal doesn't adsorb iron.
